rows.corpus_definition: Always behaving or happening in the same way.
rows.example_en: She is a consistent worker who meets all deadlines.

rows.corpus_definition: The body of a person who has passed away.
rows.example_en: They found the old corpse in the dark cave.

rows.corpus_definition: To break into very small pieces.
rows.example_en: The dry cake began to crumble away.

rows.corpus_definition: The young offspring of certain wild animals.
rows.example_en: The bear cub played near its mother.

rows.corpus_definition: To prepare land and grow crops on it.
rows.example_en: The farmers cultivate corn on their large land.

rows.corpus_definition: Increasing by adding more parts together over time.
rows.example_en: The cumulative effect of pollution is damaging the environment.

rows.corpus_definition: Clever at getting what you want, often by tricking others.
rows.example_en: The cunning fox escaped the trap easily.

rows.corpus_definition: The virtual place where computer users communicate and share information.
rows.example_en: Much of our life is now spent in cyberspace.

rows.corpus_definition: A violent storm with winds that turn in a circle.
rows.example_en: The cyclone destroyed many houses in the area.

rows.corpus_definition: Having an unusual or wrong physical shape.
rows.example_en: The metal bar was twisted and clearly deformed.
